name: DSFR for Drupal - Picker - Media
description: Provides feature to create custom pictograms as media.
project_description: Submodule of DSFR for Drupal - Picker. Lets site editors contribute their own pictograms as media entities instead of shipping them in code. On install it creates a 'Pictogram' media type (SVG source image field, requires the svg_image module), a 'Pictograms custom categories' taxonomy vocabulary, an optional category reference field, and the matching form/view displays. Two hook implementations then feed those media entities into the picker: hook_dsfr4drupal_picker_pictograms() lists every published 'pictogram' media grouped by its category term, hook_dsfr4drupal_picker_pictogram_path_alter() resolves each media identifier to the underlying SVG file URL, and hook_dsfr4drupal_picker_group_label_alter() replaces category group keys with the translated taxonomy term label.
